program: Frontier wave 5 — famous Mathlib theorems, tier 2
principle: Landmark KNOWN theorems Aristotle can close via Mathlib. Famous mathematics kernel-verified, NOT open-problem resolution. AXLE gates.

queue.statement: Sylow's first theorem: for a finite group G and a prime p, a Sylow p-subgroup exists — i.e. the type Sylow p G is nonempty. State: for [Group G] [Fintype G] and a prime p, Nonempty (Sylow p G). (Use Mathlib's Sylow existence instance / Sylow.nonempty.)

The Chinese remainder theorem: for coprime m n, ZMod (m*n) is ring-isomorphic to (ZMod m) × (ZMod n). State: for m n : Nat with Nat.Coprime m n, there is a ring equivalence ZMod (m*n) ≃+* (ZMod m × ZMod n). (Use Mathlib's ZMod.chineseRemainder.)

Bezout's identity: for integers a b, there exist integers x y with a*x + b*y = Int.gcd a b. State: for a b : Int, ∃ x y : Int, a*x + b*y = (Int.gcd a b : Int). (Use Mathlib's Int.gcd_eq_gcd_ab / Bezout.)

The Cauchy-Schwarz inequality in a real inner product space: for vectors x y, |⟪x, y⟫| ≤ ‖x‖ * ‖y‖. State for [InnerProductSpace Real E] and x y : E: |inner x y| ≤ ‖x‖ * ‖y‖. (Use Mathlib's abs_inner_le_norm.)

Bolzano-Weierstrass: a sequence taking values in a compact set has a convergent subsequence. State: for a compact set s in a metric space and a sequence f : Nat -> s-underlying with all f n ∈ s, there is a subsequence converging to a point of s. (Use Mathlib's IsCompact.tendsto_subseq.)

Heine-Cantor: a continuous function on a compact metric (uniform) space is uniformly continuous. State: for a compact space X and continuous f : X -> Y (uniform spaces), UniformContinuous f. (Use Mathlib's CompactSpace.uniformContinuous_of_continuous / IsCompact.uniformContinuousOn.)

The Banach fixed-point (contraction mapping) theorem: a contraction on a complete nonempty metric space has a (unique) fixed point. State: for [CompleteSpace X] [Nonempty X] and ContractingWith K f, ∃ x, f x = x (f (ContractingWith.fixedPoint ...) = it). (Use Mathlib's ContractingWith.fixedPoint / fixedPoint_isFixedPt.)

The Baire category theorem: in a complete metric space, a countable intersection of dense open sets is dense. State: for [CompleteSpace X] and a countable family of dense open sets, their intersection is dense. (Use Mathlib's dense_iInter_of_isOpen / BaireSpace instance.)

The Stone-Weierstrass theorem (polynomial form): on a compact interval, polynomial functions are dense in the continuous functions (uniform norm). State: the closure of the subalgebra of polynomial functions on [a,b] is the whole space of continuous functions. (Use Mathlib's polynomialFunctions_closure_eq_top / ContinuousMap.subalgebra... Stone-Weierstrass.)

Cayley's theorem: every group embeds into the symmetric group on its underlying set. State: for [Group G], there is an injective group homomorphism G ->* Equiv.Perm G. (Use Mathlib's MulAction.toPermHom / Equiv.Perm.subgroupOfMulAction, MulAction.toPerm injective.)
